title: Token Board Book
sub: Build and print the four-page token board book: a Choices page (what the student is earning), a Teaching Targets page (the skill or replacement behavior being taught), the student’s own Board (First, Then, and the token slots) and a Tokens page where the token cards park, each with its instruction text on the back, plus the picture cards and tokens to cut out. Laminated and bound on the left, with the tabs on the right. Pictures come from the shared pictogram library or from photos you upload.
